title: Celestial Cowboy Shaman
description: A luminous, ethereal cowboy figure stands centered with arms raised, radiating golden light from a sunburst halo. The translucent figure wears a hat, holds a staff, and is surrounded by floating bells in a grid formation, white cattle, and swirling pastel energy against a soft abstract background.
